resources.string:
WELCOME TO PANTRYWISE

1. ADD FOOD
Tap Add Food to enter a food name, quantity, unit, storage location and expiration date. You can also scan a barcode to fill in the name.

2. STORAGE LOCATIONS
Use Fridge, Freezer and Pantry to view the food stored in each place.

3. SEARCH FOOD
Use the search bar to find food items in the selected location.

4. EXPIRATION STATUS
Fresh: the food is not close to expiring.
Use Soon: the food expires within 3 days.
Expired: the expiration date has passed.
Every morning PantryWise sends one reminder about what needs attention.

5. EDIT FOOD
Tap a food item to edit its details or record what happened to it: consumed, wasted, expired or donated.

6. RECIPES AND AI
Find recipes, ask the AI assistant what to cook with what is about to expire, and save your favorites.

7. MEAL PLANNER AND SHOPPING LIST
Plan meals for the week. The shopping list only adds the ingredients you do not have yet, and you can share it.

8. WASTE STATS
See how much food you consumed, wasted, or donated.
Quantity must be greater than zero
